description: This file implements thread-local storage management and mutex synchronization primitives for the Starboard platform, including thread-specific data handling, mutex initialization, locking, unlocking, and cleanup, with support for thread-local destructors.

classes.name: ThreadLocalEntry
classes.description: Structure representing thread-local data entry with destructor and value.

methods.name: ThreadLocalDestructor
methods.description: Destructor function called for thread-local data when a thread exits.

methods.name: ThreadLocalInit
methods.description: Initializes the thread-local key for thread-specific data.

methods.name: EnsureInitialized
methods.description: Ensures that a CRYPTO_STATIC_MUTEX is initialized in a thread-safe manner.

methods.name: CRYPTO_MUTEX_init
methods.description: Initializes a CRYPTO_MUTEX with pthread mutex and condition variable.

methods.name: CRYPTO_MUTEX_lock_read
methods.description: Acquires a read lock on the mutex, allowing multiple readers.

methods.name: CRYPTO_MUTEX_lock_write
methods.description: Acquires a write lock on the mutex, exclusive access.

methods.name: CRYPTO_MUTEX_cleanup
methods.description: Destroys mutex and condition variable resources.

methods.name: CRYPTO_STATIC_MUTEX_lock_read
methods.description: Locks a static mutex for reading, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: CRYPTO_STATIC_MUTEX_lock_write
methods.description: Locks a static mutex for writing, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: CRYPTO_STATIC_MUTEX_unlock_read
methods.description: Unlocks a static mutex for reading.

methods.name: CRYPTO_STATIC_MUTEX_unlock_write
methods.description: Unlocks a static mutex for writing.

methods.name: CRYPTO_get_thread_local
methods.description: Retrieves thread-local data for a given index.

methods.name: CRYPTO_set_thread_local
methods.description: Sets thread-local data and destructor for a given index.
